description: ClickHouse aliases type as the functions they name, combinators included (replace, trim, date_diff, YEAR, any_value, group_concat, array_agg, medianExact, BIT_AND); the calendar keys, week and month ends, five-minute and sub-second truncation and the toIntervalUnit functions; toStartOfInterval typed by its interval's unit, toDateTime of a DateTime64 or a Date; transform, the human-readable formatters, the splitting functions and windowFunnel and retention; and the t-digest and timing quantiles give Float32, as ClickHouse returns them
